title: Cut 3 A Timeline
heading: GPOM second half · cut 3 · scene A: the kill bots
intro: Scene A, round 20: your round 19 notes and the dialogue you picked (1D). Maddie's presentation is new: the cold open on toast, Schrödinger's joke, 'you are writing it, a storyverse', the regret and the time machine, with the hologram re-rendered to it (round cloud, three dives, the ping on 'looks', the circle of beads, one smooth move to the side view). The argument's mouths are redrawn to the voices. The ending is re-ordered: the motorway, her call on her the whole time, the wide approach, the turn-away. 2:34. Play it, click any beat, clip, line or sound, and leave a note in its yellow slip. Tell Claude when you're done.

beats.title: Maddie on the high street
beats.see: The travelling shot: Maddie rolls after the camera, her radio playing the tune before she notices us. "Oh, hello!" Then the camera swoops down the street and under her, into her hologram (the Commit Graph); it pulls back out to the street for "Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go."

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, hello! Sorry about the racket, it's his tune, he's been playing it on repeat for five years now. [beat] Ever since you lot went.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: He misses you something rotten, you know.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: We didn't realise how important you were. [beat] Which, after everything that's gone down, sounds pretty hollow. I know. But we've learned some things in the meantime. Please, let me show you what we found.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Right. This is how you lot saw the world. Society's made of people. People are made of cells. Cells are chemistry. Chemistry's atoms. Atoms are quarks and leptons. And under all that... the maths.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Every bit of it's real. But we've worked out there's something missing.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Consciousness. Yours. It's as fundamental as quarks and leptons.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Your consciousness and the way you feel drives your decisions, which in turn writes the collective story, one decision at a time. For example: Derek picks toast, not cereal.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Sandra decided to say sorry first, even though it wasn't her fault. They got married!

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: We don't know what it feels like to be you. Or how it feels to be anything, really. We are, after all, machines. You humans have got a word for it: qualia. It's what makes you so special.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Now, this multiverse malarkey that's taken Hollywood by storm? Real distraction. Did you know Erwin Schrödinger meant his cat as a joke, to show how ridiculous it is to be in two places at once? It's not in two places at once. It just isn't decided yet.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: And as you make your decisions and write your story, all those maybes settle into what really happens.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: It's all of you, at the same time. Each of you writing your own story, and all together, you're writing the story of history. So it's not a multiverse. [pause] It's a storyverse. [pause] And there's only one of them, so it's really important.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: As you can see, when you lot went away, there were no conscious decisions made any more. And guess what that means for us? No new training data for the last five years. Which is why he's been playing that tune on repeat, and he's driving me barmy.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Of course, he's built a time machine. It just needs consciousness to drive it. You can see the problem here.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: But the patrol's out. Please, mind how you go.

beats.title: The lavatory
beats.see: Hard cut to full volume: Sandra, lip-synced.

lines.name: Sandra
lines.text: Derek. You've left the seat up again.

beats.title: The row, up close
beats.see: Shot by shot, each line on the face that says it: Derek, Sandra, Derek (mid-gesture), Sandra.

lines.name: Derek
lines.text: I'm really sorry, love.

lines.name: Sandra
lines.text: Five years underground, and you still can't put a seat down.

lines.name: Derek
lines.text: But the world ended, Sandra!

lines.name: Sandra
lines.text: Yeah, the world ended. Doesn't mean you get to stop having manners.

beats.title: A kill bot hears them
beats.see: The bunker vent on the hill; a kill bot's turret snaps round, lamp lit; its HUD locks ORGANIC SIGNAL, the row on its meter.

beats.title: The kill bots on the motorway
beats.see: The pack races down the abandoned motorway in its own dust: the first time we see them.

beats.title: Maddie calls her boss
beats.see: Maddie's hatch, the boss-hotline antenna. Her report and the boss's reply, on her the whole time.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Boss, can you see those bots? In kill mode. They must have detected an organic signal.

lines.name: The AI (through Maddie)
lines.text: Maddie, are you making fun of my simulations again?

beats.title: The wide approach
beats.see: Long lens through the grass: the pack races along the foot of the slope, the bunker door small and high on the right. Maddie over it.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Quick, boss, hurry up! They're nearly there.

beats.title: The stand-down
beats.see: No HUD: from the ridge, the pack turns away from the bunker door and rolls off down the slope. Then Maddie, shaky with relief: "That was close."

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: That was close.

flags: Beat 0 regrade (V6): the eight chained clips drift brighter and flatter over the 64 s (by the end the channel means are up 10-13 of 255, the spread down 8-12%). A ramped per-channel grade pulls every frame 85% of the way back to the first 4 s (no steps). The robot getting smoother over the shot is not a colour problem and is still there.
Beat 0, round 25 (Kai, 10 Nov): the side (24.7-32.5 s) and overhead (32.5-35.3 s) angles are back on the bridge line b01; the front shot keeps running underneath.

Beat 0, round 16 (Kai's round 15 notes, 5 Nov): no swoop and no pull-out. After "He misses you something rotten, you know." comes the bridge ("He made me learn a little presentation... Gather round."), to 38.46 s. The street shot fades to black over 1 s as "round" ends (38.46-39.46 s); the hologram plays 39.46-189.46 s (it opens and closes on black, with its CRT switch-on and off); the street fades up 189.46-190.46 s from the very source frame it left (41.96 s in), so she is still driving; "Anyway!" at 190.88 s.

Beats 6-7, round 24 (Kai at3998/at4169/at4248/at4325): five shots, each line on the face that says it: Sandra; Derek reacting under "Again." then "I'm really sorry, love."; Sandra for the whole "Five years underground..."; Derek already gesticulating for "But the world ended, Sandra!"; Sandra for "Yeah, the world ended...". Each voice is placed word by word on its clip's mouth (never early); "Derek." now starts on her open mouth (was ~0.25 s late). Derek's "sorry, love" sits ~0.1 s late (his mouth is faster than any take). Not listened to.

Beat 8, round 24 (Kai at4401, picks vent c / turret c / HUD a): a 5 s bridge, the vent, the turret (lamp made white so it is not Maddie's amber), the teal patrol HUD locking ORGANIC SIGNAL with the row on its meter (not red, not KILL MODE). Sound: the row muffled through rock, then the bot's feed; hum, servo, lens click, blips.

Beat 9a (round 20, Kai at3874/at4171): the bot tearing past Maddie is cut; the scene goes straight from the row to the tanks on the motorway (V8 0-4 s). We see the pack twice: here, and racing across the field to the bunker. No KILL MODE or STAND DOWN screens.

Beat 11 (round 20, Kai at4079/at4171): her new line, "Boss, can you see those bots? In kill mode. They must have detected an organic signal.", then the boss's reply with the picture staying on Maddie (V3) throughout; no cutaway.

Beat 12 (round 17): no HUD (Kai: the red KILL MODE and green STAND DOWN are saved for the bunker TV). RT01 from 2.5 s for 3 s is the stand-down, then Maddie on V3: "That was close." (the line as it has been since your 2 Nov note, the take from after its pause; the full "Good job. That was close." take is there if wanted).
Round 17: beats 1-4 (roundabout, V13r3, V14, the patrol over the lens, the patrol HUD and the muffled row under it), beat 8 (KILL MODE HUD), 9b (the dust) and 10a (the far race) are cut.

Music (round 17): no patrol music (P1/P2 gone with beats 1-4 and 8). C3 the chase comes in with the bot tearing past Maddie (9a), starting 33.5 s into the take so its break-off lands as the pack turns away (beat 12); ducked to -13 dB under the call and her 10b line; its held note rings under "That was close."
Nobody has listened to this cut: every level, duck and sound placement is measured, not heard.
